div.div: أَرْضٌ مُرَذٌّ عَلَيْهَا (As, A 'Obeyd, S, M, K) and ارض مُرَذَّةٌ (Ks, T, S, M) and ↓ مَرْذُوذَةٌ , (Th, M, K,) or the second and third of these are not allowable, but only the first is, (As, A 'Obeyd, S, M,) Land upon which has fallen rain such as is termed رَذَاذ. (As, A 'Obeyd, T, S, M, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
